cards.title: Perfume in falling petals
cards.prompt: Slow-motion macro of a faceted glass perfume bottle on black velvet while pale pink petals fall around it. One petal slides down the glass. The camera arcs a quarter turn to catch a rim of gold light on the cap. Hushed room tone, a single soft chime as the petal lands.
cards.notes: Text mode invents the bottle. For your own bottle, use product-02's reference setup.

cards.title: Your product on a turntable

references.role: clean front shot of the product

cards.prompt: @Image 1 rotates slowly on a white marble turntable under soft studio light, a thin reflection on the surface. The label stays sharp and readable through the full turn. Faint motor hum, no music.
cards.notes: Say what must not change (label, color). A plain background in the reference image keeps the focus on the product.

cards.title: Sneaker unboxing, handheld
cards.prompt: Handheld phone-style shot: two hands lift the lid of an orange shoebox on a bedroom floor, push back tissue paper and pull out a white running shoe, turning it toward the camera. Tissue rustle, a delighted "Finally!" off camera. Daylight from a window.
cards.notes: Naming the camera style (handheld, phone) steers it toward a user-generated look.

cards.title: Skincare texture close-up
cards.prompt: Extreme close-up: a fingertip swirls a dollop of pearly cream on frosted glass, the texture folding into soft peaks. Raking side light shows the shimmer. Quiet, a soft squish.
cards.notes: 4:5 is not an H3 ratio; 3:4 is the nearest portrait option.

cards.title: Watch reveal from shadow
cards.prompt: Darkness, then a thin line of light sweeps across a steel wristwatch on a slate slab, revealing the dial and the second hand ticking. The camera pushes in until the bezel fills the frame. Every tick is audible, then a low synth swell.
cards.notes: A light sweep reveals detail without a fast camera move.

cards.title: Street interview
cards.prompt: Vox-pop on a busy sidewalk: a young man in a denim jacket looks into a handheld microphone and says "Honestly? I'd take the train every day if it ran on time." Passers-by blur behind him, traffic noise, the interviewer laughs.
cards.notes: Put the exact line in quotes and give the speaker a clear look; the soundtrack is generated with the picture.

cards.title: Two people, one kitchen argument
cards.prompt: Medium two-shot in a narrow kitchen at night. A woman sets down a mug hard and says "You said you'd call." The man by the fridge answers quietly, "I know. I'm sorry." Fridge hum, a clock ticking, warm pendant light, the camera drifts slowly between them.
cards.notes: Attribute each line to a described person and keep the exchange to two lines in 10 s.

cards.title: Studio news anchor
cards.prompt: A news anchor in a navy suit at a glass desk looks into the lens and says "Good evening. Tonight: the city votes on a four-day school week." Blue studio lighting, a monitor wall behind her, a short news sting at the start.
cards.notes: Keep on-screen text out of the prompt and add it in editing.

cards.title: Your presenter, new script
cards.prompt: @Image 1 sits at a tidy desk with a laptop and says to camera "Three things I wish I knew before my first marathon." She counts on her fingers as she talks. Soft key light, plants behind her, a quiet room.
cards.notes: Use a single clear face rather than a group photo.

cards.title: Multilingual greeting
cards.prompt: A smiling hotel receptionist behind a wooden counter greets the camera: "Bienvenue, welcome, willkommen." She slides a key card forward. Lobby murmur, soft piano in the distance.
cards.notes: Short mixed-language lines are a quick way to hear how the voice handles each language before you commit to a script.

cards.title: Storm over a wheat field
cards.prompt: Ultra-wide shot: a black thunderstorm rolls over a golden wheat field at sunset, lightning forks on the horizon, the wheat bends in waves toward the camera. Slow dolly forward. Rolling thunder, wind hiss.
cards.notes: 21:9 with a slow dolly suits wide landscapes.

cards.title: Whale breach at dawn
cards.prompt: From a small boat at dawn, a humpback whale breaches close by, water sheeting off its fins, then crashes back in a burst of spray that hits the lens. Gulls, the boat engine idling, people gasping.
cards.notes: Ending on spray on the lens gives a natural cut point.

cards.title: Desert caravan at dusk
cards.prompt: A camel caravan crosses a dune ridge in silhouette against an orange sky, long shadows stretching down the sand. The camera tracks sideways at the same pace. Soft bells, wind, a distant voice calling.
cards.notes: For a 12-second take, keep one continuous motion: here a matched sideways track.

cards.title: Rain on a city window
cards.prompt: Close-up of raindrops racing down a window at night, the city lights behind them turning into bokeh circles. Focus pulls from the drops to a tram passing below. Rain patter, muffled traffic.
cards.notes: A focus pull gives a vertical frame movement without a cramped pan.

cards.title: Northern lights over a cabin
cards.prompt: A small red cabin in snow under a sky of green and violet aurora that ripples and folds. Smoke curls from the chimney; the camera tilts up slowly from the cabin to the sky. Deep silence, snow creaking.
cards.notes: Name the aurora's colors instead of leaving them to chance.

cards.title: Rooftop parkour
cards.prompt: A runner in a grey hoodie sprints across a rooftop, vaults a vent, leaps the gap to the next building and rolls on landing. The camera follows on a drone, dropping as she jumps. Wind rush, footsteps, a thud on landing.
cards.notes: Keep it to one stunt chain per shot.

cards.title: Kickflip in slow motion
cards.prompt: Low angle at board level: a skater pops a kickflip over a crack in the pavement, the board spinning beneath him in slow motion before both feet catch it. Wheels clack, the crowd off camera cheers.
cards.notes: A low angle exaggerates the height of the trick.

cards.title: Boxing pads, sweat and light
cards.prompt: A boxer throws a fast one-two into her coach's pads in a dim gym; sweat flies off in a shaft of window light. Handheld close shot, the coach calling "Again!" Leather smacks, breathing.
cards.notes: 4:3 crops tightly around two people sparring.

cards.title: Sprint start
cards.prompt: Ground-level shot of a sprinter in the blocks; the starter's pistol cracks and she explodes forward past the camera, spikes kicking up rubber crumbs. Stadium roar.
cards.notes: The 4-second minimum suits a single explosive beat.

cards.title: Same character, new place

references.role: the character, full body, plain background

cards.prompt: @Image 1 walks through a crowded night market, stops at a noodle stall and orders with a smile. The camera follows at shoulder height. Sizzling woks, chatter, lantern light.
cards.notes: Reuse the exact same image in every clip where this character appears.

cards.title: Two characters meet
cards.prompt: @Image 1 waits on a train platform; @Image 2 steps off the arriving train and they hug. The camera circles them slowly. Train brakes, an announcement echoing.
cards.notes: Give each character a distinct action so the prompt keeps them apart.

cards.title: Outfit from a second image
cards.prompt: @Image 1 wears the jacket from @Image 2 and does a slow turn in front of a mirror in a bright fitting room, then smooths the lapel. Hangers clink, soft store music.
cards.notes: State which image supplies the person and which supplies the garment.

cards.title: Product in a real setting
cards.prompt: A hiker sets @Image 1 down on the rocky summit shown in @Image 2, unzips the front pocket and pulls out a map as the wind tugs at it. Golden hour, wide lens. Wind, zipper, distant birds.
cards.notes: A location photo as a second reference shows the scene instead of describing it.

cards.title: Copy a dance
cards.prompt: @Image 1 performs the choreography of @Video 1 on a sunny basketball court, matching its timing. Fixed wide shot, sneakers squeaking.
cards.notes: The reference clip's 6 s are billed on top of the 8 s output.

cards.title: Borrow a camera move

references.role: a clip with the camera move you want

cards.prompt: Recreate the camera move of @Video 1 through a misty pine forest at dawn: the same speed, the same rise and turn. Birdsong, dripping water.
cards.notes: Keep the reference clip short (2-4 s): its seconds are billed like output.

cards.title: Lip-sync to your voice
cards.prompt: @Image 1 speaks the words of @Audio 1 directly to camera in a quiet home office, natural head movement and blinks, soft daylight.
cards.notes: Audio references are free, but H3 needs an image or video beside them.

cards.title: Cut to the beat
cards.prompt: A fast travel montage that jumps between @Image 1, @Image 2 and @Image 3 on every kick drum of @Audio 1, whip pans between places, bright summer light.
cards.notes: Up to 9 images fit in one request; each extra place is one more cut to fit in 10 s.

cards.title: Bring a painting to life
cards.prompt: The painted clouds start to drift, the river ripples and a flock of birds crosses the sky while the brushstroke texture stays visible. Gentle wind, water.
cards.notes: Ask for the medium to stay visible (brushstrokes) or it may turn photographic.

cards.title: Old family photo, gently animated
cards.prompt: The people in the photo blink and smile softly, the child turns her head toward her mother, a breeze moves the curtain. Subtle motion only, keep the film grain.
cards.notes: Ask for subtle motion; large movements risk distorting the faces.

cards.title: Day to night, same skyline
cards.prompt: Time passes over the skyline: the sun sets, clouds race, windows light up floor by floor until the night view. Locked-off camera. City hum fades to night sounds.
cards.notes: Shoot or render both frames from the identical viewpoint.

cards.title: Sketch becomes the render
frames: a pencil sketch of a chair
the finished 3D render of the chair
cards.prompt: Pencil lines thicken, fill with wood grain and fabric, and the chair turns slightly as it becomes the finished render. Pencil scratching that fades to quiet.
cards.notes: Describe the change between the two pictures, not the pictures themselves.

cards.title: Logo reveal between two frames
frames: a dark frame with scattered gold particles
the logo on a dark background
cards.prompt: The gold particles swirl inward and lock together into the logo with a soft flash. A rising whoosh and a single bass hit.
cards.notes: The last frame pins the logo, so the clip ends on it.

cards.title: Claymation breakfast
cards.prompt: Stop-motion claymation: a clay egg cracks itself onto a clay frying pan, the yolk wobbles, a little clay toast pops out of a toaster. Visible thumbprints, slightly choppy frame rate, cheerful ukulele.
cards.notes: Name the material details (thumbprints, choppy motion) that sell stop-motion.

cards.title: Paper cut-out forest
cards.prompt: Layered paper cut-out animation: a paper fox runs through a forest of folded paper trees, layers sliding at different speeds as the camera trucks right. Paper rustle, soft flute melody.
cards.notes: Parallax between paper layers gives depth without a 3D look.

cards.title: Anime rooftop duel
cards.prompt: Anime style: two swordswomen clash on a rooftop under a red moon, sparks and speed lines on each strike, cherry petals whipping past. Dramatic low angle, a beat of silence before the final strike, then a metallic ring.
cards.notes: A beat of silence before the hit gives the sound design room.

cards.title: 3D toy commercial
cards.prompt: Glossy 3D animation: a small yellow robot toy wakes up on a kid's desk, stretches, and waves at the camera before jumping into a pencil cup. Bright playful lighting, boing sound, kids laughing.
cards.notes: Draft at 768p; save 2K for the version you ship.
